title: Roof framing.
officialText:
Every roof girder and at least every alternate roof beam shall be anchored to its supporting
member; and every monitor and every sawtooth construction shall be anchored to the main roof construction. Such
anchors shall consist of steel bolts of sufficient strength to resist vertical uplift of the roof.
